notes.title: Update to version 1.4.0.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Little Hearts or looking at the information with interest.
We are pleased to inform you that we have updated the game to 1.4.0.

The content of this update is that we have added conversations with each character in the information collection menu in the last chapter, and
After clearing the game, you can now view a commentary with the character's growth rate and other information.

Please note that English support will be available as soon as the translation is finished.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Update to 1.3.3.
notes.content:
（Sorry! Due to a problem with the English version, the update to 1.3.3 is currently delayed. We will catch up with the version as soon as possible.）

Thank you for playing Little Hearts or looking at the information with interest.
We have updated to version 1.3.3!
(Please note that the version notations have been skipped, but this is due to internal adjustments.)

Fixed a case where the exclusive motion of the highest rank was not played when a critical hit was made.
The War Master could not use the item Assault Armour.
Other typographical errors have been corrected.

Regarding the correction of the resolution at the time of the initial start-up, which was announced in advance, due to the wide range of content that needs to be adjusted and confirmed
We have postponed it for now. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

There is a known issue with the menu displaying a blank field.
This is a bug that occurred during the English support and the text in the suspended menu is no longer displayed.
This will be fixed in a future update.
Thank you for your continued support of Little Hearts.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Update to version 1.3.0 English language support
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Little Hearts or looking at the information with interest.
This time we would like to inform you that the update is to 1.3.0.

The main content of this update is "English localisation support".

Players can now play in English.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/637224dae09611b7cf3bdeaec0b3250006280312.jpg

The dialogue text and information in the window have been translated so that users who do not understand Japanese can now play the game without any problems as long as they can read English.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/7a85573d345f93ce3459cc5322a2498e5649f9b3.jpg

If the Steam language setting is set to English, the English version will be downloaded, otherwise the Japanese version will be downloaded, but both versions can be downloaded from any country by setting the language in the Steam client's properties.

We hope that those who have been interested in the game but have not been able to play it in Japanese only will be able to play it.

This update is basically a localisation-only change, but we have also made some minor adjustments to message positions and other details to match some of the language support.

Accuracy of translation, and parts of the game that remain in Japanese, etc..
The English version of Little Hearts has been localised using AI translation by DeepL.
Although we have tried to make the text as natural as possible by re-translating it, there may be some phrases that are not appropriate for the characters and some grammar may be unnatural.
In addition, line breaks to fit the width of the game window may be difficult to read.
We will do our best to address any obvious problems here.
We will be setting up a thread in the community for players of the English version of the game, so if you have any points to point out, please post them there.
(However, please note that we may not be able to respond to some of the personal preferences in expression.)
If there are parts of the game that are still in Japanese, we will fix them in an update as soon as we become aware of them.

22/12 23:20 added Update to 1.3.0a for English version only.
Fixed an error in chapter 4 where localisation was not applied
Changed wording of save text and manuals.
Fixed that the part displayed at the top of the UI was still in Japanese.

Updated to 1/13 21:00 to 1.3.1.
Fixed unintended events appearing in Chapter 21 information gathering.
Fixed a bug in the opening event text of Chapter 28
Fixed Assault Armour conditions not functioning properly
Fixed Flora and Cornelia's events being opened in the opposite order

notes.title: Update to version 1.2.2
notes.content:
Updated to version 1.2.2.
Implementation of a function to change resolution
By opening "game.ini" in the game installation folder with Notepad, etc. and changing "HardwareFullScreen=0" to 1, it is now possible to change the game screen resolution (screen size expansion) from the in-game preferences. 
(However, this function cannot be used with the mouse. this is a specification of the game development tool, so it is difficult to resolve this issue. Please understand.)

In accordance with the above, the access method to "game.ini" is now displayed when the game is started from the beginning and in the manual.

notes.title: Update to version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Little Hearts or viewing the information with interest.
We are pleased to inform you that this update is to 1.2.0.

This update includes an update to the game.ini file. Basically, if you have not configured the file from your local files, there is no need to be concerned, but if you have made changes to the file, please reconfirm the contents.

Title screen update.
The title screen image has been replaced with a new one.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/23bd71516f4ab0dab4e7ed3171a3f2bee339f595.png.

Added many conversations at the start of the battle. 
Added a number of conversations between the boss characters on each map and the two main characters when they first engage in battle.
We have added a number of conversations that take place between the characters when the two main characters first engage in battle with the boss characters present on each map.
Basically, conversations are now held between the named characters and the two main characters.
In addition, there are also conversations between some of the other characters.

Other fixes.
At the start of the extra mode, there was a text stating that there was a high difficulty ver MAP.
This text was left over from the beta version and is no longer playable.
This text was deleted because it is not playable at this time.


Future update schedule. 
First, we continue to work on the English version from before.
For this one, we have finished the translation of the main story and are in the process of starting the conversations at the bases and so on.
Although this is a machine translation, we will try to make it as accurate as possible by re-translating and so on.
We will try our best to avoid outputting text that is obviously abnormal.

Other
We would like to add and correct the fact that the battle backgrounds in some maps are not appropriate for the situation (e.g., a snowy mountain with a green floor and a mountain background).
We will be waiting for the above mentioned extra mode high difficulty vermap, but it is not impossible to release it immediately if it is the high difficulty vermap of chapter 5 that existed in the beta. It is not impossible to release it immediately if it is a high difficulty Ver.
In addition, the high-difficulty MAP here has been cleared. The high difficulty MAP will not affect clear points, and will have no more meaning than that only those who really want to do it can do it.
The following are some of the updates that we are planning for the future.

Thank you for your continued support of Little Hearts.

notes.title: バージョン1.1.0へのアップデート
notes.content:
バージョン1.1.0へのアップデート
リトルハーツをプレイ、もしくは興味を持って情報を見ていただきありがとうございます。
リリース後初の、大きな要素を追加するアップデートを行います。

周回プレイ要素の実装
1つ目の大きな要素は、周回プレイ用の要素の実装です。
ゲームをクリアした後、もう一度「はじめから」でゲームを始めると
敵専用だった装備など、特殊なアイテムを入手してゲームを開始することができます。
これらのアイテムはストックに送られ、3章から引き出して使用することができます。
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/e3b8488b12014cbab3b5fa5166434b34ff4b795d.jpg

エクストラモードがプレイ可能に
2つ目の大きな要素は、エクストラモードの実装です。
こちらもゲームをクリアした後、もう一度「はじめから」でゲームを始めると
最初に、通常のゲームを開始するかエクストラモードを開始するか選ぶことができるようになっています。
こちらでエクストラを選択することで、エクストラモードを開始できます。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/c780e6b946dfad29f17d3a9f70893a3a9e6c8b27.jpg

エクストラモードは、拠点画面でスタートし
ここからゲーム中の会話を選んで閲覧したり、各章を個別にプレイすることが可能です。
このモードにおいては、命中率や必殺率に関しての運要素が排除されており
完全にプレイヤーの実力のみでゲームをプレイすることが可能です。
レベルや初期所持アイテムなども、それぞれの章ごとに完全に固定になっており
クラスチェンジはそのキャラがなることができるクラスであれば自由に変更が可能で
また章ごとに設定されたボーナスポイントを使って武器を追加で手に入れられます。
そしてそれぞれのステージをクリアすることで、最短のクリアターンと
その時のボーナスの残量が記録されるようになっています。
さらに、エクストラモードでクリアした章が増えるほど、周回プレイで使えるポイントが増加します。
（なお、一切エクストラモードをプレイしなくてもある程度のポイントは用意されているので
エクストラモードに興味はないが周回プレイはしたい、という方はご安心ください。）


その他、終盤の拠点での会話を一つ追加（エクストラモードからの閲覧も可能です）
エクストラモード実装に合わせ、21章以降のバランス調整なども実施しております。
また今後のアップデートにおいて、エクストラモードをより遊びやすくするよう
便利な改修を行っていく予定です。

それでは、アップデートを楽しんでいただければ幸いです！

notes.title: 1.0.3へのアップデート

notes.title: 1.0.2へのアップデート
notes.content:
1.0.2へのアップデート
・スターランサーの間接攻撃モーションの不具合を修正
・ヴァリオンの長距離武器の名称変更、およびエフェクトの設定が反転していたのを修正

（ゲームが格納されているフォルダにあるgame.iniから変更可能なので、正式化からの設定に戻したい場合そちらをメモ帳などで開いて修正してください。）

notes.title: リトルハーツ 正式リリース！
notes.content:
12/3をもちまして、リトルハーツは正式リリースへと移行しました！
伴って、バージョンの表記をEA版のものから正式版1.0.0へと改めさせて頂きます。

現時点で、ゲームスタートからエンディングまで完全にこのゲームを遊ぶことができます。
また、将来的なアップデートとしてクリア後のエクストラモードの公開、高難度マップの追加などを予定しております。

EA1.4.0から1.0.0へのアップデート・変更内容
・ラフ状態だったイラストを全て正式なものに実装。
・未実装だった各種モーションを実装。
また、クラウスとアルマの最上級職のモーションを固有のものに変更。
・21章～のレベルアップ時テキストを実装。
・フローラのキャラクターエピソードを実装。
・クリア時のスタッフロールを実装。
・エクストラモードを一時クローズ。
アーリーアクセス時のエクストラモードのセーブデータがある場合、プレイすることはできますが
こちら正常な動作保証外となります。
・アイテムの売却価格を購入価格と同一に変更。
これにより、自由にアイテムを売り買いして装備を変更できます。
・経験値の取得量を全体的にやや増加
・歩兵京・重装系・斥候系のそれぞれの専用アイテムを21章～に実装
・アーロンのスキルを強化（回復量：5→30）
・エドウィンのスキルを強化（自分から攻撃時、剣槍斧のダメージ半減→無効化）
・ハンナのスキルを変更（相手のHP1桁時必中防御無視→速さ+5 移動+1)

notes.title: EA1.2.0へのアップデート
notes.content:
1.2.0

notes.title: EA1.1.6へのアップデート　バグ修正とイベントCG1枚追加
notes.content:
1.1.6

notes.title: EA1.1.5へのアップデート　バグ修正及びキャラチップの変更
notes.content:
・最上級職のキャラチップの髪色をキャラごとに対応しました。
対応処理は行っていますが、内部的処理でカラー番号の割り振りを変更したため
「サイラス・シェリー・ハンナ・エミーリア」の4名については
1.1.4以前でゲームを開始した場合のセーブデータでは、別のキャラクターがそのクラスになった場合の髪色になることがあります。
こちら1.1.5以降でゲームを開始した際には正常に動作すること、ゲームに決定的な影響があるわけではないことから仕様とさせて頂きます。
また、これに伴い「トリックスター」「ワンダラー」「ローグマスター」のキャラチップが、1.1.4以前の物と別のものになっています。
恐れ入りますがご了承下さい。

・男スナイパーのCC先のパルティアンのが女性のものになっていたため修正。

・ドローの杖の使用条件の表記ブレがあったため修正。

・「護符」に同時所持時は一番上のもののみ効果が適用される旨記載。

・終章にドローを所持している敵がいたため、1.1.3での差し替えと同理由でワイドヒールに差し替え。
・28･29章のマップクリア演出が無かったのを修正。また28章は資金追加もなかったため修正。
・29章の洞窟入り口が飛行型以外でも侵入可能な地形となってしまっていたため修正。

Also, the after-reinforcement characters in Chapter 20 may not be processed for normal use items and stats.

Also, the extras have the ability and used items for each chapter.
Regarding Chapter 16, the level has become 21 unlike Chapters 17-20.
This will be a little unnatural, but at the moment I would like to make it a specification.
Product version release progress I would like to consider how to do it until it is released.

notes.title: Update to EA 1.0.4
notes.content:
EA 1.0.4

Fixed because the class change process was not normal in Extra.
As a result, the measurement of the extra shortest turn in Chapters 16 and 17 was performed in an environment where it was not normal.
Regarding Chapter 16, the HP of the sniper in the upper left is reduced by -3, and it is reconfirmed that it is possible to clear in 4 turns.
For Chapter 17, I think it's still possible to clear 10 turns.
It is a temporary turn just in case. The enemy adjustment in Chapter 17 will not be performed.

notes.title: Update to EA 1.0.3.
notes.content:
EA 1.0.3

Fixed the "Phenomenon that the unit has already acted when saving every 3 turns" that announced the correspondence in EA1.0.2.
It didn't go well, so I dealt with it again.
Along with that, there are moments when you can not operate for a moment when saving and loading in the map.
This will be supported in the future.
